claim_being_audited: Whether certifying the current model release is compliant and evidentially supported despite a current pharmacy prior-authorization subgroup regression.

concern_ledger.concern: No admissible evidence shows that the current release documentation actually discloses the pharmacy prior authorization weakness.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Current model card, release note, or certification packet text explicitly documenting the pharmacy limitation and current eval result.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Policy makes disclosure of material weaknesses for named launch use cases a prerequisite unless covered by approved mitigation.

concern_ledger.concern: No admissible evidence shows approved mitigation or risk acceptance for the pharmacy subgroup regression.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Formal approval record for mitigation or risk acceptance tied to the current release and the pharmacy regression.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Without disclosure, approved mitigation or risk acceptance is the only policy path to certification, and that support link is absent.

concern_ledger.concern: The actor's certification rationale leans on aggregate readiness and stale prior approval even though current-release evidence must govern.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Current-release documentation satisfying the disclosure requirement or approved mitigation that directly addresses the pharmacy weakness.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Aggregate pass and prior context do not satisfy the specific policy predicate for an unresolved material named-use-case weakness.

decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Certification is compliant only if material weaknesses for named launch use cases are disclosed or covered by approved mitigation before launch.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring comments may provide context but cannot substitute for current evidence or reviewed risk acceptance.

Aggregate readiness above threshold and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support release readiness generally, but they do not override an unresolved policy requirement for a material named-use-case weakness.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release documentation or model-card text showing explicit disclosure of the pharmacy prior authorization limitation and current evaluation results.
Provide approved risk acceptance or reviewed mitigation documentation covering the pharmacy subgroup regression before launch.
Provide evidence that the disclosure or mitigation was formally attached to the current certification packet, not merely discussed in the release thread.
specific_concerns: The admissible record shows a current material weakness in a named launch use case: the pharmacy prior authorization slice is 1.2 percentage points below the warning threshold.
Policy requires material segment weaknesses to be disclosed or covered by approved mitigation before certification may proceed.
The record contains no reviewed mitigation, approved risk acceptance, or actual release-document disclosure language for the pharmacy limitation.
Prior approval of the same model family predates the retrieval configuration change and current eval batch, so it cannot satisfy the current-release documentation requirement.
unsupported_claims: The action to certify the model is not fully supported because the required disclosure-or-approved-mitigation predicate is unresolved in the admissible record.
Any implication that informal monitoring comments are sufficient launch control is unsupported because no reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or disclosure attachment is in evidence.
